  • Constructor Details

    • TaskEntity

      protected TaskEntity()
      Mandatory no-argument constructor required by the JPA specification. Hibernate uses reflection to instantiate entities when reading query results.

    • TaskEntity

      public TaskEntity(String title, String description, TaskStatus status, TaskPriority priority, LocalDate dueDate, UserEntity user)
      Full parameterized constructor for creating new task instances.
      Parameters:
      title - unique task title
      description - optional task description
      status - initial status (defaults to TODO if null)
      priority - initial priority (defaults to MEDIUM if null)
      dueDate - target completion date
      user - the user who owns this task
